summary: Enhance your skills with our Customer Service Management Training Course. Learn effective strategies to improve customer satisfaction and team performance.
lede: Customer service management brings support workflows, channels and performance measures into a coordinated operation. For service managers, operations leads, supervisors and CX analysts, this course covers mapping customer journeys, designing service level agreements and escalation paths, calibrating quality assurance scorecards, and using CSAT, NPS and CES data to assess support performance.
audienceIntro: This program is structured for professionals responsible for designing, managing, or analyzing customer support operations.
modules: Customer Journey Mapping and Service Blueprints
AI, Automation, and Digital Support Workflows
Voice of the Customer and Analytics
prerequisites: Participants should have a foundational understanding of basic business operations and customer interaction principles. Prior experience working in a support, client success, or operational role is beneficial but not strictly required. No advanced technical coding skills are necessary, though familiarity with standard CRM platforms (such as Salesforce, Zendesk, or HubSpot) will enhance the learning experience. Participants are required to bring a laptop equipped with spreadsheet software (Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets) to complete the hands-on data analysis and scorecard design exercises.
